subject: geom_polygon fill does not start at y=0

messages.author: aaa4b0371e11a60a
messages.subject: geom_polygon fill does not start at y=0
parts:
Dear group,

I have a question related to how geom_polygon understands the underlying data. My preferred output would be something like Fig.1 - three groups on the same graph, filled with different colours and made visible with adjusting the alpha parameter.

library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(scales)

#Fig.1
dat <- read.delim("dat.txt")
dat <- melt(dat, id.vars="Oratio")
p2 <- ggplot(data=dat, aes(x=Oratio,y=value, fill=variable))+geom_polygon(alpha=1/2)
p2 <- p2 + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1,0.05))
p2

However, you will notice that "perc1" does not align horisontally with the x-axis at y=0. It is as an increasing offset is added to each value starting from Oratio=0.089 until the end of the data. Fig.2 shows "perc1" alone.

#Fig.2
dat <- read.delim("dat.txt")
p2 <- ggplot(data=dat, aes(x=Oratio,y=perc1))+geom_polygon(alpha=1/2)
p2 <- p2 + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1,0.05))
p2

"perc2" and "perc3" align as I would expect. Yet, the data for all three groups is, in my opinion, the same type. Changing the geom_polygon to geom_line or geom_point will display all datapoints correctly, but the output is not what I would like. Why does geom_polygon consider "perc1" to be different from the other groups? I cannot find a solution to this. Any help is much appreciated.

Best regards,
Mario

messages.subject: Re: geom_polygon fill does not start at y=0
parts:
I believe this is what you want:

ggplot(data=dat, aes(x=Oratio)) + geom_ribbon(alpha=.5,aes(ymax=value,ymin=0,fill=variable))
